issues: 聚光灯是一层 normal 叠加的径向渐变：光池中心 0.42 的暖白把主角卡中段的文字洗成一块白斑，对比度掉一截
光池外的压暗是不透明度 0.42 的灰褐色平铺，整页像蒙了一层脏纱，画面发闷
光池半径 360、边缘偏硬，落地后读作贴在卡上的白色圆盘，不像舞台光
3D 注记 “One card, one project.” 直接压在左侧邻卡的文字上，两层字互相打架，读不清
changes: 聚光灯拆成三层、各用合适的混合模式：光池外暖棕 multiply 压暗（保色相不发灰），光池内暖白 soft-light 提亮（中间调变亮，深色文字保持对比），再叠一层 0.12 的 screen 轻抬亮
光池整体放大约 1.3 倍、衰减更软，读作打在页面上的舞台光；游走路径、收拢节奏、锁定脉冲和 vignette 时间轴全部不变
注记背后加一块同一 3D 平面、同一台相机的纸色柔光衬底（0.96→0 径向，6px 模糊），随注记一起浮入淡出，把背后邻卡的字压下去
加 0.04 颗粒；相机关键帧、rise/hover/reseat 动作弧、轮廓光束两圈和高清纹理交叉淡入一律保持原样
issuesEn: The spotlight was a single normal-blend radial gradient: its 0.42 warm-white core washed the hero card's middle text into a white blotch and cut contrast
The dimming outside the pool was a flat 0.42 gray-brown, laying a dirty veil over the whole page and making the frame look murky
The 360px pool had a fairly hard edge and, after landing, read as a white disc stuck on the card rather than stage light
The 3D annotation 'One card, one project.' sat directly over the left neighbor card's text, so the two layers of type fought and neither read clearly
changesEn: Split the spotlight into three layers with suitable blend modes: a warm-brown multiply dims outside the pool (keeps hue, no gray veil), a warm-white soft-light brightens inside (lifts midtones while dark text keeps its contrast), plus a 0.12 screen lift
The pool is ~1.3x larger with a softer falloff, so it reads as stage light on the page; the roving path, contraction timing, lock pulse and vignette timeline are unchanged
Added a paper-colored soft backing behind the annotation on the same 3D plane and camera (0.96 to 0 radial, 6px blur) that floats in and out with it, pushing the neighbor card's text back
Added 0.04 grain; camera keyframes, the rise/hover/reseat arc, the two-lap outline beam and the hi-res texture crossfade are all untouched
